checks.existence: exists_isDeveloping_jet applies `(isCoveringMap_jets M X G).existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts (ContinuousMap.id M) x₀ ⟨⟨x₀,γ₀⟩,h₀⟩ rfl`. Mathlib's theorem needs [SimplyConnectedSpace A] [LocPathConnectedSpace A] on the domain A = M, a covering p = (j ↦ j.1.1) : jets G X M → M (strict library, Déf. 12, G discrete), a map f = id and a matching base point. The lift σ is a continuous section (p ∘ σ = id); developingOfSection σ is the germ value, and jet_developingOfSection shows its jets are σ, through the étalé basic open of a chart. Correct, and it is Benzécri's proof (« une composante connexe de J(V) … définit l'application p »)
checks.uniqueness: « p est défini à une multiplication à gauche près par un élément de GS(n,ℝ) » is proved in both directions. IsDeveloping.smul: g•p is developing. IsDeveloping.existsUnique_smul_eq: two developing maps p, p' on a preconnected nonempty M satisfy p' = g•p for a UNIQUE g. The proof is clopen: the set where p' agrees near y with g₀•p is open, its complement (the points where another g works) is open, and rigidity (IsAnalyticAction) makes them disjoint. PreconnectedSpace and Nonempty come from SimplyConnectedSpace (path connected). It holds for EVERY simply connected (G,X)-manifold, with no Hausdorffness or countability

Mathlib's SimplyConnectedSpace (path connected, trivial fundamental groupoid) coincides with Benzécri's « simplement connexe » for a locally path-connected space. fidelity_summary: Prop. 2 is proved as printed, for every analytic (G,X), and instantiated for (GS(n), S(n)) and (GA(n), ℝⁿ) with no hypothesis beyond simple connectedness: existence, uniqueness up to a UNIQUE element of G, and local homeomorphism. The proof is Benzécri's: lift the identity through the covering J(V) → V. The mark is earned.
